rationale: Local desktop architectural proof on Ryzen 9 9950X3D with hardware NVIDIA rendering and loopback HTTP. Five independent fresh-client baselines per runtime; nearest-rank p95 with n=5 is the observed maximum, not an estimated population tail. Latency and process/WASM bounds use that maximum plus 25% scheduling and instrumentation allowance, rounded upwards to 10 ms or 1 MiB. Fixed shared cache and worker budgets are architectural caps, not fitted maxima. Primary-only first-useful wording clarifies the baseline: visible coarse primary demands dispatch before gallery demands. This does not claim GPU scanout, cold NFS server storage, remote-network performance or an identified browser GPU model beyond reported NVIDIA/Ampere. Separate recovery and preparation evidence is mandatory; these limits alone do not qualify the complete proof.

first_useful_ms.boundary: application startup to first primary-view region GPU resident

whole_overview_ms.boundary: application startup to all overview and visible gallery demands GPU resident

target_detail_ms.boundary: worst detection-open intent to all current demands GPU resident

visible_thumbnail_completion_ms.boundary: worst gallery-scroll intent to all current demands GPU resident

warm_revisit_ms.boundary: worst GPU fit or bookmark recall intent to all current demands GPU resident

warm_compressed_ms.boundary: clear settled decoded/GPU state to all current demands GPU resident with shared compressed cache retained

original_storage_read_bytes.boundary: prepared representation service never opens original source during viewing
